rule: Representation coverage for all 42 Chapter 0 object types (D-19). The ten ch1_scope=required objects have complete v1 schemas here (schema_file); every other object is classified and bound: owner_chapter names the runtime chapter that must write its full schema, and obligations lists the Chapter 1 rules that schema must obey. Classifications (schema_form, authority_effect, storage, hash_form) restate the frozen Phase A inventory against amended Chapter 0; the binding model updates are recorded under amendment_updates.
universal_obligations: canonical form: D-24 integers, D-25 sets and maps, D-27 instants, D-28 windows, D-30 digest spelling, D-36 closed objects, D-37 absence by omission, D-46 NFC text
identity: D-29 domains (object hash = domain(kind) over the full payload; obj-04's is the three-tier construction, D-33)
versioning: D-34 schema_version v1, D-35 compatibility

amendment_updates.obj-25: The two standalone contexts, open on U-44 in frozen Phase A, now bind through CORR-55: t-g01 (staging_delete class checks) and t-w01 (workspace_sync class checks) mint the intent; the retry context (t-i06) carries CORR-56's checks and binds the superseded intent (INV-73). intent_class is a registered enum; the row must carry effect and intent_class.
amendment_updates.obj-29: The intent binding's U-44 openness is closed: t-w01 creates the intent; t-w03's SKIPPED receipt is the no-effect branch and never counts as HAPPENED (INV-74).
amendment_updates.obj-41: The intent binding's U-44 openness is closed: t-g01 creates the intent under the staging_delete class (D-16, INV-74).

obligations: expires_utc is a D-28 window end (t-d02)
delegation_id constancy across the records of one delegation is the authority service's minting rule (Chapter 8); Chapter 1 enforces only copy-consistency in contracts (SEM-09, RV-58)

obligations: artifact_root recomputes from the closure (D-32, SEM-15)

objects.name: TaskContractRecord

objects.name: DependencyEdge

objects.name: Sequence
obligations: created by INV-40 lifecycle coupling, never a transition mint

objects.name: AttemptContract

D-24 integer domains for version and fence

objects.name: ExecutionReceipt
obligations: carries the admitted_witnesses section (D-21): witness_kind, producer, content_sha256, admitted_utc, correlation facts

objects.name: CandidateReceipt
obligations: candidate_tree bound only when finalization_class is SOURCE_MODIFYING (Phase A rule kept)
tree and artifact identities as digests (D-30)

objects.name: ActualVerificationEnvironment
obligations: captures exactly D-56's typed facts; named env vars only, never the full environment
executable identities are content addresses, never machine paths

objects.name: VerificationReceipt
obligations: per-assertion outcome source BY_VERIFIER / BY_ATTESTATION with the source's object hash (D-53)

objects.name: VerificationFailureReceipt
obligations: as obj-19's reference and binding forms (D-47, D-53)

objects.name: RemoteVerificationReceipt
obligations: SRP binds obj-27 (staged commit checked), SRPO binds obj-28 (canonical commit checked) — the Phase A path partition kept

objects.name: StandingPermitState
obligations: permitted/consumed/reserved counters in D-24 domains; INV-48 arithmetic is a Chapter 2 runtime test

objects.name: EffectIntent
obligations: carries effect (effect_id enum) and intent_class (D-39, CORR-55)
a retry intent binds the superseded intent_id (CORR-56, INV-73)
attempt-scoped contexts bind attempt_identity, reservation_held, delegation_active_at_intent; standalone contexts bind their class checks (t-g01, t-w01)

objects.name: CommitReceipt
obligations: the RV-48/RV-49 context partition kept exactly: (SL, eff-local-canonical-cas, HAPPENED) binds committed_tree, reservation_consumed, delegation_state_at_ponr; (REMOTE, eff-local-sequence-ref, HAPPENED) binds committed_tree; (SL, eff-local-canonical-cas, EXPECTED_OLD_STALE) binds reservation_released

objects.name: StagingPublicationReceipt
obligations: exists only for HAPPENED (D-51), so its bindings stay common

objects.name: PublicationReceipt
obligations: exists only for HAPPENED (D-51): always a PONR receipt, so delegation_state_at_ponr and reservation_consumed stay common (INV-41)

objects.name: WorkspaceSyncReceipt
obligations: the SKIPPED receipt closes the no-effect branch only and never counts as HAPPENED (t-w03, INV-74)

objects.name: AcceptanceReceipt
obligations: the Phase A path and class partitions kept (seven path rules; READ_ONLY adds the observation window, D-28)
binds record_hash and digest (D-30), path_taken (D-39 via ARCHITECTURE §13), and the receipts its finalization requirements name

objects.name: FulfillmentReuseReceipt
obligations: binds the six reuse preconditions (INV-50, INV-65)

objects.name: DuplicateAdmissionRecord
obligations: minted by t-c03 with P-2's duplicate facts

objects.name: RepairWaiver
obligations: binds obj-33; mints no acceptance and satisfies no edge (INV-57)

objects.name: DependencyReleaseReceipt
obligations: references edges per D-47 (record hash + edge_id)

objects.name: TransitionRecord
obligations: chain construction fixed: journal_entry_hash with the autobot/journal/transition/v1 domain; genesis omits previous (D-29, D-37; JH-1)
carries the D-55 decision payloads for t-s13 and t-c06

objects.name: ManualAttestation
obligations: kind-discriminated single type (D-20); per-kind domain labels (D-29)
ASSERTION binds record_hash, the assertion by part reference, obj-16 and the attempt (D-53); EFFECT_OUTCOME binds obj-25 (t-i07)

objects.name: SupersessionRecord / AbandonRecord
obligations: supersession_provenance on the successor record cites it (D-45)

objects.name: LegacyRecord
objects.hash_form: content_sha256 of the imported source bytes (D-48)
obligations: identity and import provenance per D-48

objects.name: StagingRefDeletionReceipt
obligations: intent binding closed by CORR-55 (t-g01, staging_delete class)
remote_delete outcome rule: an absent ref is HAPPENED (t-g02)
